chunks: Those who obeyed the call of God and His Messenger, even after they were wounded, and took heed for themselves, shall indeed have an ample reward,

key_terms.الْقَرْحُ: wounds (specifically in the context of battle)

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for those who remained steadfast and pious after being wounded in battle?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the Battle of Uhud, highlighting the resilience of the faithful who, despite initial setbacks and physical wounds, reaffirmed their obedience to Allah and the Prophet. It underscores the principle that true piety (Taqwa) and good deeds (Ihsan) amidst hardship are the criteria for the 'great reward' (Ajr Azeem), a concept central to understanding the spiritual status of the Imams and the faithful in times of trial.
